contact.title_zh: AI 工程師｜後端與系統整合

summary.en: AI Engineer with an M.S. in Electrical Engineering, focused on backend services, real-time control platforms, AI data workflows, and system integration. Experienced with FastAPI, WebSocket, React / TypeScript, Next.js, Docker, Linux, C# / .NET, MS SQL, and computer-vision / AI workflows including PatchCore; delivered systems connecting robot, vision, data, and policy services.
summary.zh: AI 工程師，具電機工程碩士背景，專注於後端服務、即時控制平台、AI 資料流程與系統整合。熟悉 FastAPI、WebSocket、React／TypeScript、Next.js、Docker、Linux、C#／.NET、MS SQL，以及包含 PatchCore 在內的電腦視覺與 AI 流程開發，能整合機器人、感知、資料與 Policy Service。

experience.company_zh: 瑞軒科技股份有限公司

en: Owned software delivery from requirements and system architecture through Docker deployment, testing, on-site integration, and maintenance for real-time AI and robotics systems.
Built a Next.js / React Flow / FastAPI / WebSocket workflow and data-recording platform that automated task execution and reached 3-4x manual throughput in the same time window.
Developed a React / TypeScript / FastAPI / ROS 2 web control and monitoring platform with real-time feedback, video, system status, control commands, and Docker / Nginx deployment.
Developed a PatchCore anomaly-detection API server and PyQt interface with ROI handling, image preprocessing, template replacement, and anomaly-score evaluation.
zh: 負責即時 AI 與機器人系統從需求分析、系統架構、軟體開發到 Docker 部署、測試、現場整合與維護。
以 Next.js、React Flow、FastAPI 與 WebSocket 建置工作流程與資料錄製平台，自動化任務執行，相同時間內資料量達人工操作的 3～4 倍。
以 React、TypeScript、FastAPI、ROS 2、WebSocket 與 Docker／Nginx 開發 Web 控制與監控平台，整合即時回饋、影像、系統狀態與控制命令。
開發 PatchCore 異常檢測 API Server 與 PyQt 介面，整合 ROI、影像前處理、模板替換與異常分數分析。

experience.company_zh: 采威國際資訊股份有限公司（ISCOM）

en: Participated in backend API development, frontend integration, and web feature implementation using C#, ASP.NET MVC, JavaScript, jQuery, MS SQL, and Git.
zh: 參與後端 API 開發、前端串接與網頁功能實作，使用 C#、ASP.NET MVC、JavaScript、jQuery、MS SQL 與 Git。
